messages.text: What are the most important S-parameters capabilities for applications in Semiconductor?

High-speed SerDes channel characterization is important because the source places SerDes, Signal Integrity, and Power Integrity in a high-speed digital test context for PCB/PCBA testing [1].
Coverage should support high-speed standards such as PCIe, NVLink, USB, HDMI, DisplayPort, MIPI, JESD204D, OIF CEI-112G, SATA, SAS, InfiniBand, and Ultra Ethernet [1].
Transmission-channel validation is central, because the source lists transmission channel, measurement path to DUT, and test board development as validation challenges for high-speed electrical interfaces [1].
Network analyzer support is relevant because the validation instrumentation list explicitly includes network analyzers [1].
Insertion loss capability is important because the signal-integrity flow lists IL as a key item [1].
Crosstalk capability is important because the signal-integrity flow lists Xtalk as a key item [1].
Eye-diagram correlation or simulation support is relevant because the signal-integrity flow includes Eye diagram [1].
TDR impedance capability is relevant because the signal-integrity flow lists TDR Impedance [1].
Package and advanced substrate relevance is supported by the source’s HDI vs Package substrate context, including CoWoS, Package Substrate, ABF, L/S, and pitch [1].
Material and stackup characterization is important because the PCB test solution flow includes Material Measurement, Material/Stackup selection, and Signal Integrity modeling/testing [3].
Dk/Df extraction is relevant because the PCB test solution list explicitly includes DK/DF extraction [3].
Roughness, Delta-L, ISD/ADK, and cable/connector testing are relevant because they are listed in the PCB test solution items [3].
PDN-related impedance or S-parameter-style analysis is relevant because Power Distribution Network appears as a validation block and network analyzers are listed among the instruments [1].
【推論】For semiconductor applications, prioritize S-parameter capabilities around insertion loss, crosstalk, DUT/test-board channel paths, package/substrate interconnects, material extraction, and PDN analysis because those are the supported high-speed SI/PI and package-related needs in the passages.[1][3]
